researchNotes: LICENSING: Techcombank is on data/licensed-institutions.json (id techcombank). GAPS: no official product page with a rate table (https://techcombank.com/khach-hang-ca-nhan/vay/vay-tieu-dung is a mainly secured consumer product up to 5 billion VND, a different product); no personal-loan fee schedule (biểu phí) or terms for unsecured loans (only corporate/credit-card fee PDFs); no insurance, application/disbursement fee or late-penalty data; credit-card installment not researched. RATE DISCLOSURE: Techcombank publishes monthly average lending-rate PDFs (e.g. https://techcombank.com/content/dam/techcombank/public-site/documents/lai-suat-cho-vay-binh-quan-khcn-techcombank-thang-06-2026.pdf) and base-rate notices, but the PDF text could not be extracted, so no figure recorded. CONTRADICTIONS (all in conflicts[]): amount 100M vs 400M vs 1B, term 20-36 vs 12-60, rate 1.2%/month vs 12.9%/year, MyCash 408 vs 380 VND/million/day. All figures come from techcombank.com blog pages that say they are compiled from general market information; several carry 'đã hết hạn' labels and publication dates differ from stated data dates. SURPRISING: the only worked example has arithmetic errors and a term below the stated online minimum. Both products are excluded from ranking until an official product page or contract is found.
